units.source_text: 到了夜色渐深之时，夕雾装出非常痛苦的样子，向柏木诉说：

en.t: When the night had grown late, Yugiri pretended to be in great distress and said to Kashiwagi:

units.source_text: “我多喝了酒，头晕目眩，痛苦难堪。

en.t: I have had too much wine; my head is spinning, my eyes are dazzled, and I feel unbearably ill.

units.source_text: 如果告辞回去，路上难免出事。

en.t: If I take my leave and go home, something is bound to happen on the road.

units.source_text: 想在尊斋借宿一宵，如何？”

en.t: I would like to stay the night at your honorable residence; would that be possible?

units.source_text: 内大臣就对柏木言道：

en.t: The Inner Minister then said to Kashiwagi:

units.source_text: “头中将啊！

en.t: Captain, my boy!

units.source_text: 你替客人安排寝所吧。

en.t: Please arrange a sleeping place for our guest.

units.source_text: 老人酩酊大醉，顾不得礼貌，先退席了。”

en.t: This old man is dead drunk and cannot mind his manners, so I shall withdraw first.

units.source_text: 说过之后便回内室去。

en.t: After saying this, he went back into the inner rooms.

units.source_text: 柏木对夕雾说道：

en.t: Kashiwagi said to Yugiri:

units.source_text: “想必是叫你借宿花阴了！

en.t: He must mean for you to lodge in the shade of the flowers!

units.source_text: 怎么办呢？

en.t: What am I to do?

units.source_text: 倒教我这引路人为难了！”

en.t: This puts me, your guide, in a difficult position!

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：

en.t: Yugiri replied:

units.source_text: “‘托身苍松上’的，岂有轻薄之花？

en.t: If one entrusts oneself to the green pine, how could there be any frivolous flower?

units.source_text: 请勿说不快之言！”

en.t: Please do not say such unpleasant things!

units.source_text: 便催他引路。

en.t: Then he urged him to lead the way.

units.source_text: 柏木心中不免怀有妒意。

en.t: Kashiwagi could not help feeling jealousy in his heart.

units.source_text: 但他一向认为夕雾人品高雅，令人称心，结果总是他的妹婿。

en.t: But he had always thought Yugiri refined in character and pleasing, and in the end he was to be his brother-in-law.

units.source_text: 因此放心地引导他到云居雁房中。

en.t: So he felt reassured and led him to Kumoi no Kari's room.
